name: cate.sqlite
description: SQLite viewer, a self-contained server-backed Cate extension. Reads the workspace's SQLite files with a bundled WASM engine (no external install) and serves a browse/query UI, reverse-proxied and loopback-bound.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:panel && node ./copy-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
